## Release checklist

These are the things CI cannot check. Tick them before merging.

- [ ] Dragged the built `ARsynth_control.tox` into a clean TouchDesigner project; it loads with no errors
- [ ] Logged in and switched a scene end-to-end against a real ARSynth show
- [ ] The `Version` par displays the number being tagged
- [ ] README still matches the component's actual parameters
